cards.text:
D-SD02/001EN
Diabolos, "Violence" Bruce
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):At the start of your Ride Phase, until end of turn, you "Final Rush". (Specific units get a power up when you are in "Final Rush"!)
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if you are in "Final Rush", [COST][Soul-Blast 5], and [Stand] all of your front row rear-guards.

D-SD02/002EN
Diabolos, "Anger" Richard
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), [COST][put a rear-guard into your soul], and draw a card.
[CONT](RC):If you are in "Final Rush", this unit gets [Power] +5000.

D-SD02/003EN
Diabolos, "Bad" Steve
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), choose a card from your soul, call it to your back row center (RC), and [Soul-Charge 1].
[CONT](RC):If you are in "Final Rush", this unit gets [Power] +5000.

D-SD02/004EN
Diabolos, "Innocent" Matt
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-SD02/005EN
Time-fissuring Fist Colossus
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [Soul-Charge 1]. Then, if you are in "Final Rush", [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of turn.

D-SD02/006EN
Icicle Ein, Aizer
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000

Steam Gunner, Brody
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Shield] +5000 until end of that battle.

D-SD02/008EN
Acrobat Presenter
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC): When this unit attacks or boosts, if your vanguard is "Diabolos, "Violence" Bruce", [Soul-Charge 1], and if you are in "Final Rush", [Soul-Charge 1].

D-SD02/009EN
Psychic Prima, Miranda
Normal Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-SD02/010EN
Spiritual King of Determination, Olbaria
Trigger Unit｜ -｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn!

D-SD02/011EN
Diabolos Girls, Maimai
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] Trigger +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD02/012EN
Diabolos Boys, Jake
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD02/013EN
Diabolos Officer, Kilian
Trigger Unit｜ Dark States｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000

(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)
